title: List All Primes Up To N
description:
Return a list of all prime numbers up to and including `n`. A prime is a number greater than 1 divisible only by 1 and itself.

**Example:**
```
primes_up_to(10) → [2, 3, 5, 7]
primes_up_to(2) → [2]
primes_up_to(1) → []
```
hint: For each number from 2 to n, check if any number from 2 to sqrt(i) divides it. If none do, it's prime.
